 Likutay Mooharan 11:4

 טל תורה
 
 Notarikon

 The dew of Torah (טל תורה) — Tal = 39 — corresponds to the 39 categories of forbidden labor (ל"ט מלאכות) on Shabbos. The dew of Torah — 39 — sweetens and corresponds to the 39 prohibitions of Shabbos.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 159

 טנת"א
 
 Notarikon

 Tanta (טנת"א — the Aramaic word for "basket / vessel," and a Kabbalistic acronym) is the Torah — for its letters stand for the four levels of Torah interpretation: טa'am (cantillation notes), נikud (vowel-points), תag (the crowns on letters), and אos (the letters themselves). The Torah is thus a fourfold vessel: letters, crowns, vowels, and cantillation.

 י׳ × 7
 
 Gematria

 The letter Yud seven times (7 × 10 = 70) = the gematria of ע׳ (Ayin, the letter whose numerical value is 70). Seven Yuds = one Ayin — the divine point multiplied seven times becomes the eye of wisdom.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 94

 י׳, י"ק, יק"ו, יקו"ק
 
 Gematria

 The four progressive expansions of the Divine Name — י׳ (10), י"ק (20), יק"ו (36), יקו"ק (26+26=... ) — together sum to ע"ב (72), the highest of the Divine Names.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 1

 י׳י א׳לקינו י׳י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Hashem our G-d, Hashem" (י׳י א׳לקינו י׳י) [Deuteronomy 6:4 — the Shema] spell א׳ברהם י׳צחק י׳עקב — the three Patriarchs. [Cross-reference from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 42

segments.he: מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי אָרֶץ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת ארמ"ע רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֵשׁ מַיִם רוּחַ עָפָר. [ליקו"מ ח']

 The 12 tribes contain 49 letters in their names — corresponding to the 49 letters in the two verses of Shema and Baruch Shem (שמע ישראל and ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד).

 Furthermore: the 12 words in those two verses correspond to the 12 tribes — teaching that the unity of Israel declared in the Shema is literally spelled out in the tribes' names.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 36:3

 י'בוא ב'רנה נ'ושא א'לומותיו

 The first letters of "He shall come with joyful song, bearing his sheaves" (י׳בוא ב׳רנה נ׳ושא א׳לומותיו) [Psalms 126:6] spell נביא (navi, "prophet"). The one who comes bearing Torah sheaves in song is the prophet.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:2

 Roshay Saveivos

 Both yevul (יבול, "produce") and yovel (יובל, "Jubilee") derive their first letters from the verse ו׳יצא י׳צחק ל׳שוח ב׳שדה — "And Yitzchak went out to meditate in the field". [Cross-references from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:11; II:1; 14

 Likutay Mooharan 177

 י, הו, ה — שולחן
 
 Gematria

 The progressive expansions י, הו, ה — i.e. Yud (10), Heh-Vov (11), Heh (5) — together with the word יקרבנו ("He shall draw him near") = gematria of שולחן (shulchan, "table"). The divine drawing-near is set at the table.
 
 Chayay Mooharan §476

 יהו'ה רוע'י ל'א אחס'ר
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 The final letters of "Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack" (יהוה רועי לא אחסר) [Psalms 23:1] spell ריאה (reyah, "lung"). The shepherd's care fills the lungs — breath and divine protection are one.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 12

segments.he: מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא תַּרְיַ"ג. [ליקו"מ ל"ו]
segments.en:
יהושע
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Yehoshua (יהושע, Joshua) — first letters of י׳קומון ה׳קיצו ו׳רננו ש׳וכני ע׳פר: "Arise! Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust!" [Isaiah 26:19 — the great verse of resurrection]. Yehoshua's name encodes the resurrection of the dead.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 13

 י׳-ו׳ — Torah and Tablets
 
 Notarikon

 The letters Yud-Vov (י׳ ו׳) embody the Torah: Yud corresponds to the Ten Commandments (עשרת הדברות); Vov (= 6) corresponds to the Tablets — for their length was 6 [handbreadths] and their width was 6.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 34:6; 38:7

 יוד
 
 Tziroof

 The spelling of the letter Yud (יוד) = permutation of דַּוָי (davay, "sickness") [cross-reference from Section 4].

 Gematria

 Yud spelled out (= 20) = gematria of כף (kaf, the letter Kaf = 20). The Yud spelled is the Kaf.

 Shape / Form

 Yud embodies the aspect of yad ("hand") [cross-reference above].

segments.he: מנצפ"ך בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא רי"ו דִּין. [ליקו"מ ל"ז]
segments.en:
Notarikon

 Yud-Vov is the aspect of malapoum (מלאפום) — the vowel that fills the mouth — for Yud is the point and Vov is the extension into sound. Furthermore: Yud-Vov = the aspect of 10 kinds of pulse [dikin] and 6 corresponds to the extension of the spirit — together they form the full sound.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:82; 66:2; 8:9; 34:5

 יוד ונון — צ׳
 
 Shape / Form

 A Yud and a Nun together (יוד ונון) form the shape of the letter Tzadi (צ׳). [The Tzadi is composed of a Nun with a Yud riding upon it — the righteous one (tzadik) carries the divine point upon the extended form.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 67:4

 יוד וד׳ — ה׳
 
 Shape / Form

 A Yud and a Dalet together (יוד וד׳) form the letter Heh (ה׳). [Cross-references from Sections 4 and 5.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:3; 97

 יוה"ך
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 The Divine Name יוה"ך (Yud-Vov-Heh-Chaf) appears as the final letters of כי׳ מלאכיו׳ יצוה׳ לך׳: "For He will command His angels for you" [Psalms 91:11].

 Roshay Saveivos

 Also the first letters of ו׳המשכילים י׳זהירו כ׳זהר ה׳רקיע: "And the wise shall shine like the brightness of the firmament" [Daniel 12:3]. [Cross-references from Section 6.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §195

segments.he: מָן רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת מַאֲמַר נֶאֱמָן. [ליקו"מ נ"ו]
segments.en:
יוחאי

 Yochai (יוחאי — as in Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, author of the Zohar) appears as the final letters of כי׳ לא׳ תשכח׳ מפי׳ זרעו׳: "For it shall not be forgotten from the mouth of his children" [Deuteronomy 31:21]. This verse opens Likutay Mooharan.
 
 
 Opening of Likutay Mooharan

 יום טוב
 
 Gematria

 Yom Tov (יום טוב, "festival / good day") = gematria of the Divine Name ס"ג [63] together with the 10 letters of the Name Havayah in its full spelling. The festival carries within it the Name of Binah and the full Name of G-d.

 Likutay Mooharan II:15

 Tziroof

 Yam Suf (ים סוף, "the Sea of Reeds / Red Sea") — its letters are a permutation of מיוסף (me'Yosef, "from Yosef"). The Sea of Redemption contains the name of Yosef — for Yosef's bones were carried through those very waters [Exodus 13:19].

segments.en:
י'ם ש'ברת ר'אשי ת'נינים

 The first letters of "You broke the heads of the sea-monsters" (י׳ם ש׳ברת ר׳אשי ת׳נינים) [Psalms 74:13] spell תשרי (Tishrei). The breaking of the sea-monsters encodes the month of Rosh Hashanah — the breaking of evil is the beginning of the new year.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 11

 ימין

 Likutay Mooharan 6:7

 יעקב

 Yaakov (יעקב = 182) = gematria of Elokim twice (172) plus the 10 letters of those two words (172+10=182). [Cross-reference from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 41

 יצחק
 
 Tziroof

 Yitzchak (יצחק) — its letters spell קץ חי (ketz chai, "the living end / the end that is alive"). Yitzchak embodies the living endpoint — the sefirah of Gevurah that is also chai (life).

 Roshay Saveivos

 Yitzchak — first letters of ז׳מן ק׳וף צ׳דיק י׳שנים: "the time of the sleeping of a righteous one." [Cross-reference from Section 7.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:79

 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 13

 ירא בשת / ירא שבת

 Both ירא בשת ("fear of shame") and ירא שבת ("fear of Shabbos") are permutations of בראשית ("In the beginning"). [Cross-references from Section 2.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 38:7; II:72

 יראה / ירה

 Yirah (יראה, "fear / awe" = 216) = gematria of yarah (ירה, "he taught / he shot") with the kollel — and conversely, yarah with kollel = yirah = gevurah (216). Fear and teaching arise from the same source. [Cross-references from Section 3.]
 
 
 Marginal gloss to Likutay Mooharan 38; 38:7

 ירושלים
 
 Notarikon

 Yerushalayim (ירושלים, "Jerusalem") = יראה שלם (yirah shalem, "complete awe / the wholeness of awe"). Jerusalem is the city of perfect, complete awe of G-d.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 59:1; II:1; 4

 Likutay Mooharan 19:8

 ישראל

 Yisrael — first letters of א׳ל ש׳די י׳תן ל׳כם ר׳חמים: "May El Sha-dai grant you mercy" [Genesis 43:14]. [Cross-reference from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:62

 יתגדל / יתקדש

 Yisgadal (יתגדל, "May [His Name] be magnified" — the opening word of Kaddish) — its letters contain תגי דל (tagei dal, "crowns of the poor one / the tagin of the Dalet"). The magnification of G-d's Name is rooted in the crowning of the poor and humble.

 Yiskadash (יתקדש, "May [His Name] be sanctified") — its letters contain תק שדי (tak Sha-dai, "the power of Sha-dai"). Sanctification of the Name draws upon the Name Sha-dai.

 יתרו

 Kosel (כותל, "the Wall / Western Wall") is read as כ"ו תל — "the mound of 26" — Kuf-Vov = 26, the gematria of the Divine Name Havayah. The Western Wall is the mound that bears the Name of G-d.

 כ"ח אתוון / כח מעשיו / כ"ח פרקין
 
 Gematria

 The 28 letters of the first verse of Creation (כ"ח אתוון דעובדא דבראשית) — "In the beginning G-d created the heavens and the earth" [Genesis 1:1 has 28 letters] — correspond to three things that each equal 28:

 (1) כח מעשיו ("the power of His deeds") [Psalms 111:6] = 28;

 (2) The 28 joints of the hands (כ"ח פרקין דידים);

 (3) The general concept of koach (power) = 28.

 The 28 letters of Creation, the 28 joints of the hands, and the "power of His deeds" are numerically one — the body enacts the creation.

 כף קלע
 
 Gematria

 Kaf Kela (כף קלע, "the hollow of a sling") = gematria of שין (shin, the letter Shin = 360). The sling and the letter Shin are numerically one — the sling of David that felled Goliath carries the power of the letter of fire.

 כ'פרה ל'כל ת'ולדותם
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "atonement for all their generations" spell כלת (kales, "bride / completion"). [Cross-reference from Kales above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 151

 כרסיה
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 Kursaya (כרסיה, Aramaic: "His throne" [Daniel 7:9]) yields two first-letter acronyms:

 (1) ר׳אש ה׳שנה י׳ום כ׳פור ס׳וכות — the three holy days of Tishrei: Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkos. The divine throne contains the three great festivals;

(2) כ׳רסיה ש׳ביבין ד׳י נ׳ור — "His throne was flames of fire" [Daniel 7:9] — first letters spell שדכן (shadchan, "a matchmaker"). The fiery divine throne is the matchmaker of all holy unions.
 
 
 Chayay Mooharan §84

 כשפר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Kashofar (כשפר, "like a shofar") — first letters of the four modes of shofar blowing: פ׳שוט כ׳פול ש׳לוש ר׳בוע — "simple, double, triple, quadruple" — the four tones of the shofar call.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:8; 1

 כתר
 
 Notarikon

 Keter (כתר, "Crown" — the highest sefirah) cannot be pronounced without the letter Kaf — for Keter begins with Kaf, and the Kaf requires a Peh to be spoken (see first entry above). The Crown is accessed through the mouth — through holy speech.
 
 Marginal gloss to Likutay Mooharan 6

 Likutay Mooharan 123

 ל'בושה ו'תשחק ל'יום א'חרון
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 (2) = gematria of תלמוד (Talmud = 480) — the antidote to nocturnal impurity is Torah study;

 (3) = ת"פ (480 = Tav-Peh).

segments.he: מְצַחֵק רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת חֲזֵה צִיּוֹן קִרְיַת מוֹעֲדֵנוּ. [ספורי מעשיות מעשה ו' בסופו]
segments.en:
Ma'kel (מעקל, "crooked / winding path") — its letters are a permutation of עמלק (Amalek). The crooked path is Amalek — the force that seeks to bend and distort the straight way.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 11

 מערב
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Ma'arav (מערב, "west / evening") — first letters of ר׳חל מ׳בכה ע׳ל ב׳ניה: "Rachel weeping for her children" [Jeremiah 31:14]. The west — where the sun descends — encodes Rachel's weeping, for she weeps as light fades into exile.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:67

 מ'מצרים ו'לא י'ראו פ'ני ר'יקם
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "from Egypt and they shall not see My face empty-handed" (מ׳מצרים ו׳לא י׳ראו פ׳ני ר׳יקם) spell פורים (Purim). The redemption from Egypt carries within its first letters the festival of hidden redemption. [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:74

 מצחק
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Metzachek (מצחק, "one who laughs / plays") — first letters of ח׳זה צ׳יון ק׳רית מ׳ועדנו: "See Zion, the city of our appointed times." [Cross-reference from Section 8.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan (end of story of the humble king)

 מצר — צמר
 
 Tziroof

 Metzar (מצר, "distress / narrow strait") — its letters are a permutation of צמר (tzemer, "wool"). The narrow straits of suffering contain within them the warmth and softness of wool — comfort is hidden within distress.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 29:10

 מצרימה' את' יעקב' איש' וביתו'
 
 Sofay Saveivos

segments.he: מִיכַל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה לָּךְ. [חיי"מ תנ"ו]
segments.en:
The final letters of "to Egypt, Yaakov, each man and his household" (מצרימה את יעקב איש וביתו) [Exodus 1:1] spell תשובה (teshuvah, "repentance / return"). The very verse describing the descent into Egypt — the beginning of exile — contains in its final letters the word for return. Exile carries within it the seed of return.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:73

 מצת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Matzas (מצת, "[he] sucked / drew out") — first letters of צ׳דקה ת׳ציל מ׳מות: "charity saves from death" [Proverbs 10:2]. Drawing forth life through charity saves from death.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 201

 מקל — ואו
 
 Shape / Form

 Makel (מקל, "staff") has the shape of the letter Vov (ואו). [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 1

 מִקֵּץ — קָמַץ
 
 Tziroof

 Mikeitz (מִקֵּץ, "at the end of" [Genesis 41:1 — Yosef's dream interpretation after two years]) — its letters are a permutation of קָמַץ (kamatz — the vowel-sign below the letter, the broadest and most open vowel). The "end" (keitz) contains the full open vowel — the moment of redemption is the most fully-open divine utterance.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 54:6

 מר דרור / מרדכי
 
 Notarikon

 Mar Deror (מר דרור, "pure myrrh" [Exodus 30:23] — the first spice of the holy anointing oil) is an aspect of Mordechai (מרדכי) — for Mordechai is the Aramaic translation of Mar Deror.

 Gematria

segments.he: מביח"ו רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וְנֹחַ מָצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְיָ. [חיי"מ תס"ג]
segments.en:
Mordechai (מרדכי) = gematria of ורב חסד ("and abundant in lovingkindness" [Exodus 34:6]). Mordechai embodies divine lovingkindness.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 10:8; 56:2; 60:9

 מ'ראה ט'עם ר'יח — מטר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "sight, taste, smell" spell מטר (matar, "rain"). [Cross-reference from Matar above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 12

 מראה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Mareh (מראה, "vision / appearance") — first letters of ר׳שע מ׳כתיר א׳ת ה׳צדיק: "the wicked surrounds the righteous" [Habakkuk 1:4]. The vision of the wicked surrounding the righteous is itself a kind of appearance — the distorted vision of evil masking holiness.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 11

 מרים יוכבד — נא רפא
 
 Gematria

 Miriam and Yocheved (מרים יוכבד — Moshe's sister and mother, the two great women of the Exodus) together = gematria of נא רפא ("please heal" [Numbers 12:13 — Moshe's prayer for Miriam when she was stricken with leprosy]). The women who saved Moshe's life contain within their names his prayer for their healing.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 174

 משה
 
 Multiple

 Moshe (משה) — the great cluster of Moshe's gematria and acronym connections:

 (1) Tziroof The letters of Moshe = ש׳ מה — "the Shin of Mah" [the 300 of the letter Shin + the Name Mah (45)];
